claim: A fixed finite catalog of exact morph attempts may be tried from one immutable checkpoint; every nonterminal or failed attempt must roll back hash-identically before the next attempt.
structural_reverse_contract: affine rows must be exactly n disjoint canonical x_i XOR c_i = 1 pairs
image clauses must be negative Horn-image clauses of width 1..3 over exactly the two paired halves
decoded source must re-encode byte/semantic-identically to image horn+affine payload
no source hash or provenance field may be trusted by this morph
decoded source may terminate only in frozen 2CNF, Horn, or dual-Horn native solvers
checkpoint_contract: all attempts receive a fresh immutable copy of the original checkpoint
attempt failure or nonterminal result cannot mutate later input
checkpoint hash before and after every rolled-back attempt must match
failed attempts remain append-only in ledger
frozen_controls: corrupted-provenance dense positive image must terminate via direct AT_MOST_2 before structural reverse
corrupted-provenance mixed general 3CNF must remain OPEN
corrupted affine-pair image must remain OPEN
every rollback hash must equal initial checkpoint hash
portfolio output must match direct native/reference semantics on exhaustive small controls
captain_obvious_firewalls: fixed morph order; no score, ranking, randomization, retry-until-success, or adaptive reordering
no full assignment cube inside candidate
portfolio size and discovery work are charged
success_condition: All exact controls pass, distinct controls exercise distinct portfolio paths, rollback is hash-identical, and unsupported general 3CNF remains OPEN.
falsifier: Any semantic mismatch, checkpoint drift, forged terminal, hidden heuristic authority, or unsupported instance promoted from OPEN.
